```{=html}
<style>
/*
  Schedule page styles
  Colours drawn from site SCSS:
    $primary:   #0a3263  (navy)
    green tint: #eaf4f1  (matches .text_block)
    green text: #1d5c3a
    navy tint:  rgba(10,50,99,0.08)
    font:       Source Sans Pro (inherited)
*/

*, *::before, *::after { box-sizing: border-box; }

.sched-wrap { margin: 2rem 2%; }

/* ── Desktop table ──────────────────────────────────────── */
.sched-table-wrap { overflow-x: auto; }

.sched-table {
  width: 100%;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  table-layout: fixed;
  font-family: inherit;
  min-width: 620px;
}

.sched-table th {
  background: rgba(10, 50, 99, 0.06);   /* navy tint */
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 0.75rem;
  padding: 10px 12px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(10, 50, 99, 0.12);
  text-align: center;
  color: #0a3263;                        /* $primary */
}

.sched-table td {
  padding: 10px 12px;
  border: 1px solid rgba(10, 50, 99, 0.1);
  vertical-align: top;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  line-height: 1.4;
}

.sched-table td.time-col {
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #0a3263;
  width: 56px;
  min-width: 56px;
  text-align: center;
  background: rgba(10, 50, 99, 0.04);
  font-size: 0.72rem;
  white-space: nowrap;
  vertical-align: top;
  padding-top: 8px;
}

.sched-table td.break-row {
  font-style: italic;
  opacity: 0.5;
  text-align: center;
  vertical-align: middle;
}

/* ── Session labels ─────────────────────────────────────── */
.lbl {
  display: inline-block;
  font-size: 0.62rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  padding: 2px 7px;
  border-radius: 3px;
  margin-bottom: 5px;
  letter-spacing: 0.06em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
}
/* Keynote → green (matches .text_block / .abs-badge-keynote) */
.lbl-keynote { background: #eaf4f1; color: #1d5c3a; }
/* Masterclass → navy tint */
.lbl-lecture { background: rgba(10, 50, 99, 0.08); color: #0a3263; }

.talk-title {
  line-height: 1.35;
  margin-bottom: 4px;
  font-size: 0.78rem;
  font-weight: 600;
}
.talk-speaker {
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  margin-top: 3px;
  opacity: 0.6;
}
.talk-time {
  font-size: 0.68rem;
  margin-top: 6px;
  opacity: 0.35;
}

/* ── Special event cells ────────────────────────────────── */
/* Buffet / closing → green */
.event-buffet,
.event-closing {
  background: #eaf4f1;
  color: #1d5c3a;
  text-align: center;
  font-weight: 500;
  vertical-align: middle;
}
/* Wine reception → navy tint */
.event-wine {
  background: rgba(10, 50, 99, 0.06);
  color: #0a3263;
  text-align: center;
  font-weight: 500;
  vertical-align: middle;
}
/* Coffee & Careers → neutral */
.event-generic {
  background: rgba(0,0,0,0.02);
  text-align: center;
  vertical-align: middle;
}
td.empty { opacity: 0.15; text-align: center; vertical-align: middle; }

/* ── Mobile cards ───────────────────────────────────────── */
.mobile-sched { display: none; }

.day-card {
  margin-bottom: 2rem;
  border: 1px solid rgba(10, 50, 99, 0.12);
  border-radius: 6px;
  overflow: hidden;
}
.day-card-header {
  background: rgba(10, 50, 99, 0.06);
  padding: 10px 14px;
  font-weight: 700;
  font-size: 0.82rem;
  color: #0a3263;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(10, 50, 99, 0.12);
}
.day-card-row {
  display: flex;
  align-items: flex-start;
  padding: 10px 14px;
  border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.05);
  gap: 10px;
}
.day-card-row:last-child { border-bottom: none; }
.day-card-time {
  font-size: 0.7rem;
  font-weight: 700;
  color: #0a3263;
  white-space: nowrap;
  min-width: 80px;
  padding-top: 2px;
}
.day-card-content {
  flex: 1;
  font-size: 0.8rem;
  line-height: 1.4;
}
.day-card-row.break .day-card-content {
  font-style: italic;
  opacity: 0.5;
}
/* Green rows — buffet & closing */
.day-card-row.event-buffet-row,
.day-card-row.event-closing-row  { background: #eaf4f1; }
.day-card-row.event-buffet-row .day-card-content,
.day-card-row.event-closing-row .day-card-content { color: #1d5c3a; font-weight: 500; }
/* Navy tint — wine reception */
.day-card-row.event-wine-row     { background: rgba(10, 50, 99, 0.06); }
.day-card-row.event-wine-row .day-card-content    { color: #0a3263; font-weight: 500; }
/* Subtle — Coffee & Careers */
.day-card-row.careers-row        { background: rgba(0,0,0,0.02); }
.day-card-row.careers-row .day-card-content { }

@media (max-width: 680px) {
  .sched-table-wrap { display: none; }
  .mobile-sched     { display: block; }
}
</style>
```
